purpose: Representative predictor baselines under the immutable A_main downstream protocol

baseline_families.native: Raw waveform amplitudes, source-only normalization, model-native temporal processing; tree models receive waveform statistics only
baseline_families.controlled: The same complete HealthToken local/global values and validity masks as TRACE; no upstream pretraining except disclosed external MOMENT

comparison_rule: Same train/validation/test devices, label budgets, seeds, target, metrics and validation checkpoint rule; never mix legacy archived results with this protocol.
validation: 20% interval selection within independently selected source labels
test_usage: metrics only; excluded from scaling, fitting, validation, stopping, and hyperparameter choice

svr_rbf.input: complete flattened HealthToken history and masks
svr_rbf.selection: fixed prespecified hyperparameters; validation is reported but not used for test tuning

cnn_lstm_attention.input: complete HealthToken history through native local-position CNN

patchtst.input: complete HealthToken history through learned snapshot interface and temporal patches

itransformer.input: same complete HealthToken snapshot interface as PatchTST; learned variate histories as attention tokens; scalar RUL head

external_pretraining_disclosure: MOMENT results must be marked as external pretraining and must not be interpreted as architecture-only comparisons.
